CryoEM Particle Picker Dependencies
This tool requires Python 3+ with the following packages: - numpy - scipy - mrcfile - scikit-image - matplotlib - h5py - pandas
These are automatically installed via pip when the tool runs. No manual installation required.
The crYOLO model (193 MB) is downloaded automatically on first use.
No conda dependencies - uses Galaxy's Python environment with pip.
